candidates.title: Ligonier Ministries builds guardrails into its AI answer assistant
candidates.summary: Ligonier's AI answer assistant (Ask Ligonier, described as part of its Grow app) draws only on the ministry's teaching library, stays in a sandbox, hands off to a real person when pushed past its limits, points users who mention suicidal thoughts to a crisis hotline, and does not pretend to be human. CEO Chris Larson says it should not take the place of a pastor, elder or parent.
